description: Build all settings screens in SwiftUI (20+ settings pages). Implement Settings app-style UI with Form/List views. Include general settings, player preferences, subtitle/audio settings, quality/bandwidth controls, Trakt.tv OAuth flow, TMDB configuration, addon management, theme selector, parental controls with PIN, backup/restore UI, profile management. Use Rust SDK storage layer for persistence.
